feedback_interpretation: Recent feedback weakened broad response-transfer assumptions. m26 was overpredicted at both 20/1 and 50/1, while m202 at 10/1 was dramatically underpredicted, so solvent response cannot be shifted globally. Ethyl anthranilate was also overpredicted at intermediate ratios, supporting direct curve repair. The m61 reversal persisted across loading, and m92 continued to show ratio- and endpoint-specific loading behavior. The m45 neighborhood still supports local sampling around an isolated near-coincident interval rather than propagation to a general acid-family rule. These outcomes increase the value of condition-matched controls and chemically diverse probes of high-retention regions.
batch_rationale: The batch combines local response repair, loading and ratio coverage, donor-free controls, and chemically distinct high-retention probes. Aminoester, ester, diketone, ketone, aldehyde, halogenated, fused-aromatic, and basic scaffolds are represented, with matched conditions where they discriminate loading or solvent effects. This should help QGeoGNN learn which corrections transfer across the Row-distribution and which remain scaffold-specific, while improving both V1 and V2 prediction.
